name: konductor
description: Konductor is an open-source AI agent framework that automates the software development lifecycle (SDLC). It ships a coordinated team of specialist agents -- product manager, architect, developer, QA, researcher, technical program manager, browser, media analyzer, plus three orchestrators -- each with scoped tools, skills, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Agents hand work to each other through a structured delegation protocol.
